row: We specialize in relieving pain and improving mobility in dogs so they can get back to the things they love. We provide an individualized rehab plan specific to your pet's needs with one-on-one care and guidance from our experienced therapist. We come right to your home so you don't have to worry about car rides or stressful vet visits. We treat various conditions including CCL tears, hip dysplasia, elbow dysplasia, arthritis, muscle strains, and more. Services includes laser therapy, massage, stretching, ultrasound, pulsed electromagnetic field therapy, targeted exercise, assistive devices, orthotics/braces, and more.
